import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    p = params
    w = 0.4173
    s = np.sin(w*t); c = np.cos(w*t)
    h = p[2] + p[3]*s + p[4]*c + p[5]*t + p[6]*t*s + p[7]*t*c + p[8]*t*t + p[9]*np.log(t)
